data.body_html:
If you want to feel the wind in your hair and the sun on your skin without needing a boating license, Marbella boat rental no license maximum speed options are exactly what you need. Our fleet includes a speedboat that hits 40+ knots, all with a professional skipper at the controls. From Puerto Banús, you can blast along the Costa del Sol coast, past the Golden Mile and the cliffs of Cabopino, in complete safety. No paperwork, no exams—just pure speed and Mediterranean luxury.

Why Choose a No-License Boat Rental in Marbella?

Spain’s maritime regulations require a license for anyone driving a powered vessel over a certain size. By including a licensed skipper on every charter, we bypass that requirement. You board, the skipper handles navigation, and you focus on the fun. That means you can enjoy maximum speed without any bureaucratic hassle. All our boats—from the compact speedboat to the massive Ferretti 94—come with a skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance included in the price.

Maximum Speed Options in Our Fleet

For pure adrenaline, our Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) is the star. It can reach over 40 knots (about 74 km/h), making it one of the fastest no-license rentals in Marbella. If you want a larger vessel, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) also offers high speed and includes a free jet ski for even more fun. Here’s a quick comparison:

Where Can You Go at Full Throttle?

The Costa del Sol coastline offers several excellent spots for high-speed cruising. From Puerto Banús, you can head west towards the exclusive Sotogrande port or east past the sand dunes of Cabopino. The waters off Marbella’s Golden Mile are usually calm, especially in the morning, allowing for safe high-speed runs. Popular destinations include the secluded Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés, where you can drop anchor for a swim before speeding back.

What’s Included in Every Charter?

Transparency matters. Every rental includes: a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish VAT (21%). There are no hidden fees. The price you see is the price you pay. For example, the Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours, all inclusive.

How to Book Your No-License Speedboat

Booking is straightforward. Visit our main page at Boat Rental Marbella and browse the fleet. For the speedboat or any other vessel, contact us via WhatsApp for pricing and availability. We recommend booking at least 48 hours in advance, especially during July and August when demand peaks. All charters depart from Puerto Banús, with optional pickup from Marbella Marina.

Safety First: Skipper and Insurance

Maximum speed doesn’t mean reckless. Our skippers are licensed professionals who know the local waters, currents, and weather patterns. They will ensure you have a thrilling but safe experience. The boat is fully insured, and safety equipment—life jackets, fire extinguishers, first aid kit—is always on board. You can focus on the fun while we handle the rest.
